channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Sunday for $3 million renovation through July 2027
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a year-long $3 million renovation that will nearly double capacity from 18 to 44 boat slips.

item.title: Palm Beach County schools earn third straight A rating with record 93.5% graduation rate
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County received an A rating from the state for the third year in a row, with 84 percent of district-operated schools rated A or B.

item.title: Juno Beach residents demand fence at JB-7 beach access as dispute heads to budget talks
item.description: Colony Condos residents say beachgoers have been trespassing on private property since the town removed a fence at the JB-7 public beach access in 2023.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to win 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was one of just 10 communities nationwide to receive the prestigious 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League.

item.title: Martin County Maritime Response Unit puts two boats on standby for Fourth of July boaters
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit will have two boats with medics on standby in the north and south county as hundreds of boaters hit the water this holiday weekend.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation preserves Fort Pierce history and hosts artists from around the world
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce operates in the historic Crain Estate and runs an artist-in-residency program attracting international artists.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court challenge Thursday against an administrative law judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year .

item.title: Breast cancer patient's insurance denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, had her breast reconstruction surgery denied by Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield less than 24 hours before the scheduled procedure.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board is pushing back against a judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year following controversial social media .

item.title: St. Lucie County deputies crack down on impaired driving ahead of July 4th weekend
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office is conducting enhanced patrols targeting impaired drivers during the Independence Day holiday period.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach was named one of just 10 communities in the U.S. to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League and was the only Florida city selected.

item.title: Port St. Lucie council moves forward on land transfer for Midway Road Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: The Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation for a partial interchange at Midway Road and the Florida Turnpike.

item.title: Fort Pierce breast cancer patient denied insurance coverage hours before reconstruction surgery
item.description: Beth Clark's insurance company, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, denied coverage for a reconstruction procedure less than 24 hours before it was scheduled, citing the surgical mesh as investigational.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue 2 boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday. Both occupants ended up in the water but were wearing life jackets that kept them afloat while help arrived.

item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man who lost fiancée Misty Dawn White in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the couple's home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiancé Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed many of his and White's belongings.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation in Fort Pierce offers art classes and tours of historic Crain Estate
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, preserving the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain and connecting local and international artists through its artist-in-residency program.

item.title: Stuart's downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation to nearly double slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation expected to be complete by next Fourth of July. item.title: Martin County maritime teams deploy two medic boats for Fourth of July weekend
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit is placing two boats with medics on standby in the northern and southern parts of the county as hundreds of boaters take to the water for the holiday weekend.

item.title: Martin County School Board challenges judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk post
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court document Thursday fighting a judge's recommendation to reinstate Matt Theobald, a Spectrum Academy teacher suspended for Facebook comments about Charlie Kirk.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in house fire, community raises funds for fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, died Monday in a Hobe Sound house fire that preliminary findings suggest was caused by an electrical issue. Friends have launched a fundraiser for her fiance Mark.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic to Florida Turnpike near Orlando
item.description: AAA estimates 72.2 million Americans will travel at least 50 miles from home between June 27 and July 5, with 61.4 million making the trip by car. Orlando and Miami rank among the top five travel destinations.

item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football program is targeting a state championship during the 2026 fall season after finishing last year with a 10-2 record and a district title. item.description: North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse host a full day of free activities including a pool party, live music and fireworks at 9 p.m.

item.title: Florida State Parks offer free admission for America's 250th Independence Day
item.description: The Florida Department of Environmental Protection waived admission fees at state parks from Friday through Sunday to mark the semiquincentennial celebration.

item.description: Communities across Southwest Florida are marking America's 250th birthday with celebrations from Sarasota's bayfront to Fort Myers Beach.

item.description: Ocala and Marion County are celebrating the semiquincentennial with synchronized fireworks at four locations and a parade through the city.
